game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Sunken Altar, an altar half-sunk in earth: the scholar mage must handle rune wisps while practicing lists. Core idea – Comprehension Lab: Build new lists in one line with list comprehensions to transform relic shards.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Sunken Altar: an altar half-sunk in earth
core_gameplay_loop: In Sunken Altar, repeat each round: Build new lists in one line with list comprehensions to transform relic shards. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the lab_output value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 12 consecutive correct decisions about lab_output to power up the scholar mage and open the moon altar.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 7 (applied tier): Comprehension Lab
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Comprehension Lab' (Week 7 slot 11), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Sunken Altar'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how lab_output changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rune wisps in Sunken Altar.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 12.
